purpose: REAL pinned upstream base-image provenance for the node VM QCOW2 build. Every image is an immutable dated Ubuntu Cloud Images release entry with a verified non-placeholder SHA256 and a GPG-signed checksum file. Fixture placeholders live only in base-images.fixture.json.

retrieval_evidence.method: targeted direct HTTPS GET/HEAD against official Canonical hosts (no web search); gpg 2.4.9 local verification
retrieval_evidence.directory_listing: https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/noble/ lists release-20261017/ as the immutable dated release entry; /release/ is the moving symlink and is NOT used as a pin
retrieval_evidence.signature_packet: gpg --list-packets: signature packet algo 1, keyid 1A5D6C4C7DB87C81, issuer fpr v4 D2EB44626FDDC30B513D5BB71A5D6C4C7DB87C81, sig created 2026-10-17
retrieval_evidence.gpg_verify: gpg --verify SHA256SUMS.gpg SHA256SUMS -> Good signature from UEC Image Automatic Signing Key <cdimage@ubuntu.com>; primary key fingerprint D2EB 4462 6FDD C30B 513D 5BB7 1A5D 6C4C 7DB8 7C81; exit 0 (warning: key not locally certified, fingerprint matched signature issuer and keyserver key)
retrieval_evidence.image_head: HEAD each image_url -> HTTP 200 with content lengths recorded above; full image bytes were NOT downloaded

verification_rule: In artifact mode, refuse any image whose digest_status is not 'verified', whose expected_sha256 is a placeholder/repeated character, or whose checksum_url/signature_url/signing_key_fingerprint/retrieval evidence is missing. A real build must fetch checksum_url, verify its GPG signature against signing_key_fingerprint, and require the downloaded image SHA256 to equal expected_sha256. No silent fallback to another image, the moving /release/ symlink, a daily image, a host image or a fixture.
fixture_rule: Offline tests use provenance/base-images.fixture.json explicitly. Fixture digests are synthetic and must never be used for artifact claims.
